May 19, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Virtu Financial Llc decreased its stake in Nuance Communications Inc (NUAN) by 65.13% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Virtu Financial Llc sold 40,278 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.16% with the market. The institutional investor held 21,561 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $353,000, down from 61,839 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Virtu Financial Llc who had been investing in Nuance Communications Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $4.05 billion market cap company. The stock increased 4.26% or $0.56 during the last trading session, reaching $13.7. About 4.57 million shares traded or 72.08% up from the average. Nuance Communications, Inc. (NASDAQ:NUAN) has declined 7.39% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 18.94% the S&P500.
